_ordering_rationale: Comparable sales = KPI roi (drive marche), AUV = qualite unitaire, restaurants = expansion, total revenue = synthese.

kpis.signal: KPI roi Chipotle, suivi minute par le marche. 5 ans positifs malgre rebond COVID
kpis.description_fr: Variation des ventes pour les restaurants ouverts depuis au moins 13 mois pleins. KPI roi pour la restauration cotee, drive la sentiment marche.
kpis.description_en: Revenue change for restaurants open at least 13 full calendar months. Hero KPI for listed restaurant operators, drives market sentiment.

kpis.signal: Productivite unitaire elite secteur, >3M$ par unite = top tier restauration USA
kpis.description_fr: AUV : ventes moyennes trailing 12 mois par restaurant ouvert depuis au moins 12 mois. Indicateur cle de la productivite unitaire, Chipotle est leader sectoriel.
kpis.description_en: AUV : trailing 12-month food and beverage revenue averaged across restaurants open at least 12 months. Key unit-productivity metric, Chipotle is a sector leader.

kpis.signal: Objectif long terme 7000 restaurants en Amerique du Nord, ~285-315 ouvertures/an
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de restaurants Chipotle en exploitation a la fin de l'annee (USA + international owned-operated). Tracking direct de l'expansion vers cible 7000 unites.
kpis.description_en: Total Chipotle restaurants in operation at year-end (US + international owned-operated). Direct tracking of expansion toward the 7000-unit long-term target.

kpis.signal: Mix digital structurel >35% post-COVID, Chipotlanes drainent app et delivery
kpis.description_fr: Part des ventes food and beverage realisees via site web, app Chipotle ou agregateurs de livraison (definition revisee debut 2022 pour inclure Chipotle Rewards). FY20-21 calcul sur total revenue, FY22+ sur food and beverage revenue.
kpis.description_en: Share of food and beverage revenue from website, Chipotle app or third-party delivery aggregators (definition revised early 2022 to include Chipotle Rewards). FY20-21 vs total revenue, FY22+ vs food and beverage revenue.

kpis.signal: Croissance 5/5 ans, doublement sur 4 ans, momentum 2024 record
kpis.description_fr: Revenus consolides Chipotle (food and beverage + delivery service). Doublement sur 4 ans tire par expansion footprint et hausse AUV.
kpis.description_en: Chipotle consolidated revenue (food and beverage + delivery service). Doubled in 4 years driven by footprint expansion and AUV growth.
